subject.title: Bug: Dashboard session WebSocket degrades to screenshot-only rendering after long session + subagent wait

question: Should this Dashboard/WebSocket degradation stay as a distinct bug, or should maintainers fold it into an existing subagent delivery or session-lock canonical issue after collecting diagnostics?
rationale: The source and related issues show a shared wake/delivery failure family, but the Dashboard screenshot-only rendering and WebSocket-session degradation are not proven to be the same root cause.

options.title: Keep as distinct Dashboard bug
options.body: Track this issue separately until a webchat-focused repro or diagnostics export proves the screenshot-only degradation is only a duplicate symptom.

options.title: Fold into delivery tracker
options.body: Treat the active-run wake failure as covered by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92076 and move only the Dashboard-specific evidence there.

options.title: Fold into lock tracker
options.body: Treat the long-session compaction and restart recovery as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88647 if diagnostics show session-lock pressure is the primary cause.

recommendation.title: Keep as distinct Dashboard bug
recommendation.body: Track this issue separately until a webchat-focused repro or diagnostics export proves the screenshot-only degradation is only a duplicate symptom.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest current-history owner for both the active-wake path and the webchat tool-stream files touched by the likely proof path.
